# Gustavo Arriaga

> Freelance web developer and designer based in Houston, Texas. Builds websites, custom
> software, branding and local SEO, and 3D models and prints for small businesses.

Computer Science senior at the University of Houston, taking on freelance client work.
Contact is through the form on the site or by email at gus@arriagagustavoo.com.
There is no phone number listed.

The site is available in English and Spanish. The Spanish version lives at
https://arriagagustavoo.com/es and is described in https://arriagagustavoo.com/llms-es.txt.

## Services

- **Software products** — custom websites, web applications and internal tools, full stack.
- **Design and SEO** — branding, graphics, and local SEO: Google Business Profile, the map
  listing, reviews, and the on-page setup that lets Google read the site.
- **3D modeling and printing** — CAD design, prototypes and finished custom prints.

## Website packages

Three tiers, priced from a starting figure and settled in a written proposal:

- **Basic** — an informational site: branded pages, a contact form, and the technical SEO baked in
  (sitemap, page titles, schema, speed and mobile checks). No database and no Business Profile work.
- **Standard** — adds a backend, so the site stores what comes in and the owner gets a private
  admin page to read bookings, orders, messages and sign-ups. Customer accounts optional.
- **Premium** — adds fully custom design, full branding, and Google Business Profile setup.

Every package includes monthly maintenance from launch: uptime, bug fixes and small tweaks.
It is part of the package, not optional, but either party can end it on 30 days' notice.
New features are quoted separately.

SEO setup (one-time) and SEO care (monthly) can be added to any package. Setup covers the Google
Business Profile, name/address/phone consistency and review setup; SEO care covers keeping the
profile current, review replies and a monthly report. It does not include content writing or
link building, and no ranking position is promised.

## Working terms

- A deposit on signing, the remainder on delivery. Zelle, bank transfer or check.
- Domain and hosting are registered in the client's name, on the client's payment method.
- Out-of-scope work is quoted in writing and needs approval before it starts.
- Either party can end the arrangement on 30 days' notice, with accounts and data handed over.
- Clients own the data their site collects and the documents it generates, and receive a
  licence to the application.
